title: Parisuddha
text: 1.2. Sāvatthi || || Tatravoca || pe || || 3. Aṭṭhime bhikkhave dhammā parisuddhā- -uppajjanti nāññatra sugatavinayā || || 4. Katame aṭṭha || || Seyyathīdaṃ || sammādiṭṭhi || la-pe || sammāsamādhi || || Ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha dhammā parisuddhā- -uppajjanti nāññatra sugatavinayā ti || ||
